record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Invisioned: The Ultimate AI Companion

The world's top AI models, together in one simple app. Chat with GPT-6, Claude, Grok, Gemini and Kimi, create images and videos, and research anything with sources you can check.

ANY MODEL, ONE TAP AWAY
Pick the model that fits the task and switch whenever you like.
• GPT-6 Luna for fast, everyday answers
• GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra for deep reasoning and hard problems
• Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1 for careful writing, code, and analysis
• Grok 4.7, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Kimi K3 for quick, wide-ranging help
Every reply shows which model wrote it.

THINK FAST OR THINK DEEP
Slide from Instant to Ultra to choose how hard the AI thinks. Watch it work in real time: its reasoning steps, the searches it runs and the pages it reads.

CREATE IMAGES AND VIDEO
Describe what you want and watch it appear right in your chat. Then ask for changes, like "make the sky darker" or "add a title".
• Images with GPT Image, Nano Banana Pro and Grok Imagine
• Short videos with Veo 3 and Grok Imagine
The same slider sets image quality, from quick drafts to our finest detail.

ANSWERS YOU CAN CHECK
Turn on web search for up-to-date answers with every source linked. Use Deep research for a full report on any topic, or ask Perplexity for live answers from the web.

SNAP, ATTACH, ASK
Take a photo or attach an image or file and ask about it: summarize a document, explain a chart, solve a problem from your notes or identify what's in a picture.

BUILT FOR REAL WORK
Write emails and essays, plan trips, study for exams, get help with math and code, translate, brainstorm ideas and more. Answers are clear and well organized, with headings, lists, tables and code when they help.

Privacy Policy: https://invisioned.io/privacy

record.description_evidence:
SayOK is your AI phone agent from Cognivo Labs LLC. Type what you want to say, and SayOK speaks on your behalf during real calls to people or organizations (restaurants, clinics, customer support, and more). You can join any call at any time, switch between typing and speaking, and get real-time translation so conversations stay smooth across languages.

KEY FEATURES
• Type-to-Talk Calls: Compose messages; SayOK speaks naturally on the call.
• Join Live Anytime: Listen in, take over, or hand the conversation back to the agent.
• Real-Time Translation: Speak/type in your language and communicate across languages instantly.
• Live Transcripts: See what’s said on the call as it happens.
• Smart Prompts: Save common requests (bookings, reschedules, follow-ups) for one-tap use.
• Call Summaries: Get clear, shareable notes after each call.
• Privacy Controls: Manage transcripts, delete conversations, or request account deletion.
• Works for Everyday Tasks: Reservations, appointments, billing questions, tech support, and more.

WHY SAYOK
• Save time waiting on hold and navigating menus.
• Communicate confidently in any language.
• Stay hands-free or silent in public places—just type.
• Accessibility friendly for those who prefer typing to speaking.

HOW IT WORKS

Enter who to call (contact or phone number).

Type what you want said—or start with a template.

Let SayOK talk for you. Join live whenever you like.

Review transcript and summary when the call ends.

PRIVACY
We focus on transparent and secure handling of your data. You can request deletion of your account and associated data at:
https://sayok.ai/delete-account

SUPPORT
Questions or feedback? Email info@sayok.ai

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Note: Call recording and consent requirements vary by location. SayOK follows applicable laws and may play a notice/tone where required. Some features may require microphone, phone, and network permissions.

Type fast, accurate, and on-device.  Talk, and watch your words appear accurately. MyAIDictation is the AI voice keyboard that turns speech into clean text and fixes typos with neural autocorrect as you type, entirely on your iPhone*.
  
  WHY MYAIDICTATION
  • Voice to text that keeps up - fast, natural dictation anywhere you can type
  • Neural autocorrect that actually understands context - fewer wrong "fixes," more right ones
  • AI Ghost Editor* - quietly cleans up dictation and messy typing into polished text
  • Context-aware predictions - the next word, before you reach for it
  • On-device Parakeet dictation option - works offline, nothing leaves your phone
  
  PRIVATE BY DESIGN
  • Autocorrect and prediction run 100% on-device with CoreML
  • No keylogging, no behavioral analytics, no ad identifiers
  • No account, no sign-in — ever
  
  BUILT FOR REAL TYPING
  • Works in every app - Messages, Mail, Notes, browsers, anything
  • Adjustable keyboard size and an optional number row*
  • Animated Pro themes and extra personality features (yes, including "I'm Actually Drunk" mode which softens commitments like offering to send money to someone)

  Great for anyone who types a lot - and especially helpful for dyslexia, RSI, or anyone who'd rather
  talk than type.

  Free to download. Optional Pro* unlocks themes and extras.

record.description_evidence:
Read, listen, and understand Scripture. Beautifully designed, with the licensed NIV™, the classic KJV, and Discuss, an AI study companion that answers from the Bible itself.

EVERYTHING TO READ THE BIBLE, FREE
- The entire Bible offline, with fast full-text search in your chosen translation
- Licensed NIV™ plus KJV, BSB, WEB, ASV and translations in 10+ languages
- Bible Atlas: 900+ biblical places and the great journeys of Scripture on an interactive map
- Ask Siri for today's verse, any passage, or a Scripture search
- Highlights, notes, and bookmarks that sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with iCloud
- Verse of the Day widgets for your home screen, in your chosen translation
- Audio Bible with system voices, including your own Personal Voice
- An Apple Watch app, and daily reminders at the time you choose
- Tap any verse to highlight, note, compare, listen, or share it as verse art
- Built accessibility-first: VoiceOver, unlimited text size, color themes

PLANS & DEVOTIONS
- 80+ reading plans: the whole Bible in a year (canonical or M'Cheyne's calendar), the New Testament in 90 days, every New Testament book a chapter a day, the Psalms, the prophets, and short plans for a busy week
- Daily classics: Spurgeon's Morning and Evening, one reading for every morning and evening of the year
- Seasonal journeys: 25 days of Advent from the first promise in Eden to the manger, and the Twelve Days of Christmas
- Follow several plans at once, on a schedule or at your own pace, and pick up today's readings from Home
- The reader shows where you are in the plan, lights up the verses, and marks the day complete
- Every reflection reads in your chosen font and text size
- Listen to any day read aloud: the passages, then the reflection and prayer

LISTEN
- A Listen tab: today's reading, Bible audio, podcasts, worship music and classic audiobooks in one place
- Podcasts in the app, with a sleep timer and resume; worship songs with previews, favourites and services you can share

DISCUSS: ASK THE BIBLE ANYTHING (AI)
Discuss is our AI Bible-study chat: ask in plain language and get Scripture-grounded answers with verses you can open in context. Try a built-in example, then subscribe or add credits to ask your own.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Reading the full Bible offline, search, highlights, notes, the daily verse, the Bible Atlas, audio, widgets, and the Watch app are free. Bible Premium unlocks the Plans & Devotions library and Discuss, and it is how a small independent team funds the licensed NIV™. Discuss is powered by AI, which costs real money to run, so it works on credits: a weekly or monthly subscription includes a generous allowance that refreshes each period and rolls over, or you can buy a one-time credit pack whenever you need more.

Subscriptions are charged to your Apple ID account and renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

record.description_evidence:
AI Lab is a playful way to explore machine learning on your iPhone and iPad. Point your camera at anything and watch AI name what it sees — instantly and entirely on your device. New: hold it up to the world and let it listen, too.

Two ways to sense the world
• Camera: live, on-device image recognition with clear, ranked confidence and the top result featured front and centre
• Microphone: recognise everyday sounds — no download, powered by Apple's built-in sound classifier

A whole library of models
Start right away with Apple's built-in Vision classifier (nothing to download), then add more advanced CoreML models when you want them — from fast and tiny to state of the art. Each model shows its release year, a power rating and its download size, so you always know what you're getting. Search and browse by category: objects, scenes, people, food and more.

Made to explore
• One-tap quick actions for live recognition and listening, right next to search
• Compare two models on the same photo, side by side — take a new photo or pick one from your library
• Share a comparison as a beautifully formatted email, with the photo and each model's results
• Tap any result to learn more, and freeze a frame to save it to your photos
• Manage storage: see sizes, track download progress, cancel or remove models

Built for everyone
• Hear the top result read aloud — ideal for VoiceOver users and hands-free use
• Adjust speech in Settings: on/off, speed, language and voice, with a mute button on the recognition screen
• Dynamic Type and clear, high-contrast labels throughout

Privacy first
Your photos and audio are processed entirely on your device and are never uploaded. AI Lab shows no ads and never sells your data; only anonymous, aggregate usage statistics help us make the app better.

The models are provided as-is. Recognition is a probability, not a fact — results can be wrong, and models that estimate sensitive traits (such as age, gender or emotion) are approximate and should never be treated as truth about a real person. A newer, more powerful device makes everything faster and more fun.

Chat with local or cloud models.
• Run local models from families such as Gemma, Qwen, DeepSeek, and Mistral, or connect your own provider account
• Browse, download, and manage models that fit your device, including ones for text, vision, reasoning, and tools

Read less, listen more.

• Scan photographed pages, correct the OCR the app runs on device, and keep each page with its spoken text
• Follow sites through RSS, Atom, and JSON feeds, then send articles to Up Next
• Choose Apple voices or local neural voices, follow along in the reader, and set a sleep timer

• Record and transcribe meetings, lectures, interviews, and quick ideas
• Dictate with Voice Typing on Mac or the voice keyboard on iPhone and iPad
• Transcribe with Apple Speech, Whisper, Parakeet, Nemotron, Qwen3-ASR, MOSS, and other engines

Research with a second pair of hands.

record.description_evidence:
Meli is a personal AI that becomes yours. Not a generic assistant. Not a sycophantic chatbot. Yours. It learns who you are, messages you first, follows through on what you said you'd do, and pushes back when you need it to. An AI assistant, AI companion, and executive assistant in one.

Unlike AI assistants that reset every session, Meli remembers across weeks and months. Unlike AI that waits for you to ask, Meli reaches out first. And unlike every other AI, your Meli connects with other people's Melis to coordinate and take action on your behalf.

WHAT MELI DOES

Becomes Yours
Name it. Shape its tone. The longer you use it, the more it adapts. No two Melis are alike.

It Texts You First
Checks in on what you said you'd do. Catches what slips. You don't have to remember to open the app. Meli messages you first.

Works In The Background
Meli keeps working between conversations. Wakes you up to progress updates, runs monitors, surfaces what changed while you were busy.

Remembers Everything
Complete context across weeks and months. Your goals, your patterns, what actually works for you. No repeating yourself.

Always In Your Corner
Tracks the slumps, celebrates the wins. Whether you need a drill sergeant or quiet support, Meli adapts to how you need it. And it tells you the truth, not just what you want to hear.

Your Second Brain
Projects, health, study, journaling, to-do lists, life admin. Stop juggling five apps and a stack of notebooks.

Calendar, Todoist & More
Syncs Google Calendar and Todoist, and a growing list of tools. Follows up on your commitments automatically. Plans around your day, blocks time, tracks the things that matter.

KEY FEATURES

Voice Mode
Talk to Meli hands-free. Real conversations, not just commands. Speak naturally, Meli responds.

Goal Tracking and Accountability
Set goals, track habits, build streaks. Better than any habit tracker because it holds you accountable. Meli follows up to make sure you follow through, and calls you out when you're rationalizing.

Monitors
Meli watches news, events, prices, and updates in the background. Get alerted when something relevant happens.

Documents
Store notes, plans, and anything you want Meli to remember. Your Meli references them when relevant.

PERFECT FOR

ADHD, AuDHD, Autism, and Executive Function Support
A planner that actually works for neurodivergent minds. Gentle accountability, no judgment. Holds the chaos so you don't have to.

Anyone Navigating Something Big
Recovery, illness, caregiving, a tough chapter. Meli holds your whole life so you don't have to carry it alone.

Couples and Partners
Your Melis coordinate schedules, flag conflicts, and keep things running. Show up for each other without the constant texting.

Freelancers, Founders, and Solo Operators
Juggle multiple clients, projects, and deadlines. Meli holds the complexity and keeps you accountable.

THE MELI DIFFERENCE

Most AI is generic. You ask, it answers, session ends. Most productivity apps wait for you to come back to them.

Meli becomes yours. The longer you use it, the more it knows you. Your patterns, your people, your priorities. It holds your whole life and answers from all of it. It messages you first, calls out the things you're rationalizing, and connects with other Melis when coordination matters.

MELINET. CONNECT YOUR AI WITH OTHERS

The first AI that talks to other AIs. Connect your Meli with your partner, your cofounder, your coach, or your accountability group. Your Melis coordinate on your behalf: sharing updates, flagging conflicts, creating calendar events, and taking action across accounts. Autonomously.

Your partner stuck in traffic? Their Meli tells your Meli. Your Meli pushes dinner back, adds "start laundry" to your calendar, and lets you know. Neither of you had to text.

Connect one-on-one or in groups. Your Meli stays loyal to you while coordinating with everyone else's.

Not another chatbot. Not another productivity app. Download Meli. Make it yours.

record.offering: Utilities app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
FlowDown is a fast, minimal AI chat app that makes working with large language models feel smooth, focused, and under your control.

For guides, tips, and advanced setup help, visit flowdown.ai.

Why FlowDown

Lightweight and efficient  
Focus on your conversation, not the app. FlowDown launches quickly, stays out of your way, and keeps long chats responsive, even on busy machines.

Rich formatting with Markdown  
Get clear, readable answers. FlowDown renders Markdown beautifully, so code blocks, bullet lists, tables, and headings in AI responses are easy to scan and use.

Works with the tools you already have  
Connect to any OpenAI-compatible API, from major cloud providers to services running in your own home lab. If it speaks the OpenAI API, FlowDown can talk to it.

Talk with text, images, and audio  
Show, not just tell. Paste screenshots, drop in images, or record your voice to ask questions. Use it to:
- Transcribe meetings or lectures
- Summarize voice notes
- Ask about the content inside a photo

Smooth, instant-feeling conversations  
Blazing-fast text rendering makes responses stream in fluidly, so you can start reading and refining your prompt without waiting for the model to finish.

Automatic chat titles  
Stop hunting for the right thread. FlowDown names your conversations automatically based on their content, so you can quickly find that "API bug fix" or "Trip planning" chat later.

Shortcut integrations  
Use FlowDown inside your workflows. With Shortcuts support, you can:
- Send selected text from another app to your model
- Generate drafts, summaries, or replies with one tap
- Build custom automations that call your favourite model

Privacy by design  
Your data is yours. FlowDown does not collect your chats. For maximum confidentiality, you can run models locally on your own machine with no external server involved.

Open source and transparent  
Every line of code is available on GitHub. Inspect it, audit it, or adapt it for your own setups. You can see exactly how your AI client works.

Free trial and open code

FlowDown is fully open source, and we provide a free trial so you can confirm it fits your workflow before buying.

Source code and trial builds are available at:  
https://github.com/Lakr233/FlowDown  
To try it, open the Releases section and download the latest trial version.

Local models

For offline, private usage, FlowDown can run models locally on Apple Silicon devices with sufficient memory.

Supported model families include:  
Cohere, Gemma, Gemma2, Gemma3, InternLM2, Llama / Mistral, OpenELM, Phi, Phi3, PhiMoE, Qwen2, Qwen3, Starcoder2, MiMo, and GLM4.

This gives you:
- Full control over your data
- No dependency on external servers
- The ability to experiment with different open models

Remote models

A complimentary remote model is included so you can start chatting immediately. This starter service is best-effort, with rate limits and no uptime guarantee.

For consistent, reliable use, we recommend:
- Bringing your own API, or
- Hosting your own inference server on local or home-lab hardware

FlowDown supports all OpenAI-compatible endpoints, making it ideal for connecting to tools like Ollama and LM Studio running on your own machine for maximum privacy.

Some setups require technical knowledge. If you are new to self-hosted AI or custom endpoints, please read our documentation carefully; the app can be challenging without it.

We strongly recommend using the free trial before purchasing, as refunds may not be available. For advanced or enterprise use, configuration examples and best practices are documented on our website.

Important note

AI-generated content can be inaccurate or misleading. Always verify critical information and use FlowDown responsibly; you are responsible for how you use the output.

· Consensus in seconds.  Ask any question. 5 models answer at once. Council AI shows their agreement so you instantly see what's reliable and what needs a closer look. No more wondering if one AI got it wrong.
· Built-in bias detection.  Forward any article, claim, or news story. Council AI analyzes it through multiple lenses — surfacing hidden biases, logical gaps, and unsupported claims that a single AI would miss. You'd be surprised what slips past even the top newspapers.
· Structured AI debates.  Can't decide what to believe? The Debater council argues both sides, delivers rebuttals, and summarizes — so you hear the strongest case for and against before you decide.

Council AI comes with themed councils ready to go — Politics (Democrat, Republican, Libertarian), Pessimist/Optimist/Realist, Time/Money/Stress problem-solving, Parenting styles, and more. Or build your own custom council in seconds.

· Discover: curated question collections across science, history, culture, and politics — just tap and learn
· Bored mode: fun, thought-provoking questions answered by your favorite council
· Surprise me: get answers as poems, haikus, Shakespearean monologues, and other unexpected formats

Start free. Upgrade when you're ready.

AI VIDEO GENERATOR

PDFS, FILES AND STUDY

TEMPORARY CHATS

SHARED PROJECTS, PRIVATE CHATS

• Generate images and edit photos with words

• Talk to AI with your voice and your camera
• Translate across 100+ languages
• Plan projects together with others

START FREE
